title: WSTS Autumn 2025 Forecast
summary: 2026 global semiconductor market forecast $975.46B; Logic +32.1% and Memory +39.4% are the clearest growth buckets.

title: SIA October 2025 Global Semiconductor Sales
summary: October 2025 global semiconductor sales $72.7B, +27.2% YoY and +4.7% MoM, confirming strong demand but not proving every segment has scarcity.

title: SEMI Equipment Forecast
summary: Global equipment sales projected at $133B in 2025, $145B in 2026 and $156B in 2027, driven by AI, HBM and advanced packaging.

title: NVIDIA FY2026 Q4 Results
summary: Q4 Data Center revenue $62.3B, +22% QoQ and +75% YoY; FY Data Center revenue $193.7B. Demand is visible but market expectations were already high.

title: Broadcom FY2025 Q4 Results
summary: Q4 revenue $18.0B +28%; AI semiconductor revenue +74%; Q1 FY26 AI semiconductor revenue expected to double to $8.2B.

title: AMD 2025 Q4 Results
summary: Q4 revenue $10.3B +34%; Data Center revenue $5.4B +39%. AI accelerator optionality exists but evidence is weaker than the leading bottleneck names.

title: TSMC 2025 Q4 Results
summary: Q4 revenue NT$1,046.09B +20.5%; 7nm and below 77%; 2026 capex guidance $52-56B shows strong advanced-node demand.

title: Micron FY2026 Q1 Results
summary: Revenue $13.64B; Cloud Memory revenue $5.284B with 66% gross margin, pointing to direct HBM/high-end memory value capture.

title: ASML 2025 Q4 Results
summary: Q4 net sales EUR9.7B, net bookings EUR13.2B including EUR7.4B EUV, backlog EUR38.8B. Scarcity is strong but valuation and policy risk cap action state.

title: Applied Materials FY2026 Q1 Results
summary: Revenue $7.01B; record DRAM revenue and exposure to leading-edge logic, HBM and advanced packaging.

title: Lam Research December 2025 Quarter Results
summary: Revenue $5.34B; complex 3D devices and advanced packages are key AI-era process drivers.

title: KLA FY2026 Q2 Results
summary: Revenue $3.30B; process control remains critical across foundry/logic, memory, advanced packaging and services.

title: Marvell FY2026 Q3 Results
summary: Revenue $2.075B +37%; data-center demand and Celestial AI acquisition reinforce custom silicon and connectivity optionality.
